notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, and the revised one draws the print fits listed in 710-001_SplitGearTop.scad's header: the press clearance on the MR128 and 6703 seats and the strake slots, the web bored to the bearing's outer race, and the brad hole on the shared axis. The dimensions are in that header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
